title: Learn and apply turn feedback into findings the existing gates check, and no report edits a fact
goal: querylog.py learn reads stored feedback: an outcome replaces Haiku's judged for its entry (the re-run on HEAD still decides fixed-since); a best article gives an eval finding at stage miss with that best, which apply's alias and expansion gates take as today; missed with a lead url and claim gives a gap finding whose research run receives the url and claim as quoted data; a line marked wrong with a url and claim gives a conflict finding that apply records in _conflicts.md as not settled only when quotecheck finds the claim on the page, and writes no fact; a line marked stale gives a report-only source finding for its source id; tool_issue counts per tool in the digest; helpful and irrelevant are reported, never applied; a second learn and apply on unchanged inputs change nothing.
